normalization: Every complete 512px source cell is uniformly resized to 369px, then registered by measured torso centre and planted foot to (256,448) without content cropping. Registration coordinates are in scripts/prepare-workshop-guests.py; all frames retain 48px safe padding.

guests.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Make a production transparent animation sprite sheet for the SAME character in reference image 1, preserving costume, colors, face, species, accessories and proportions. Soft painterly storybook game rendering, gentle warm upper-left light, matte textures. EXACT canvas 1536x1024, 3 columns and 2 rows, six equal 512x512 cells. NO visible grid, NO text, NO floor or background, genuine alpha transparency. In EACH cell exactly one complete character, same scale, feet baseline y=448 relative to that cell, anchor x=256. Keep ALL ears, hats, tails, props and shadows inside x=48..464,y=48..464 of its own cell. Subject height at most 380 pixels. Never cross or touch cell edges. Frame order left-to-right top-to-bottom: 1 pure left side profile walking left contact pose left foot forward; 2 pure left profile walking passing pose feet closer; 3 pure left profile walking opposite contact right foot forward; 4 pure left profile opposite passing pose; 5 standing still turned three-quarter toward viewer from left profile; 6 standing facing directly toward viewer. First four frames MUST look LEFT with clear side silhouette, NOT look at viewer. Natural gentle arm/leg gait and stable held props, no motion trails, no detached parts. Last two frames must preserve same body size and foot anchor as first four. Reference character: beige rabbit, straw flower hat, blue overalls, peach shirt, glass dew jar and leaf
